id: \bLance: My name is Lance. I'm the Champion of the Indigo Elite Four.
en: \bLance: My name is Lance. I'm the Champion of the Indigo Elite Four.
it: \bLance: Mi chiamo Lance. Sono il Campione dei Superquattro di Indigo.

id: \bYou must be a strong Trainer to have made it all the way here. Let me quickly fill you in.
en: \bYou must be a strong Trainer to have made it all the way here. Let me quickly fill you in.
it: \bDevi essere un Allenatore forte per essere arrivato fin qui. Lascia che ti spieghi in fretta la situazione.

id: \bThis group has used some kind of machine to force the Pokémon here to evolve. The Gyarados over there is going on a rampage because of it.
en: \bThis group has used some kind of machine to force the Pokémon here to evolve. The Gyarados over there is going on a rampage because of it.
it: \bQuesto gruppo ha usato una specie di macchinario per costringere i Pokémon di qui a evolversi. Per questo quel Gyarados laggiù è andato su tutte le furie.

id: \bThe one in charge of this operation is to the right of us. I'll let you decide. Do you want to stop the Gyarados or that man? I will handle the other.
en: \bThe one in charge of this operation is to the right of us. I'll let you decide. Do you want to stop the Gyarados or that man? I will handle the other.
it: \bIl responsabile di questa operazione è alla nostra destra. Scegli tu. Vuoi fermare il Gyarados o quell'uomo? Io mi occuperò dell'altro.

id: \bLance: Good job. They shouldn't be causing any more trouble.
en: \bLance: Good job. They shouldn't be causing any more trouble.
it: \bLance: Ottimo lavoro. Non dovrebbero più causare problemi.

id: \bDon't think you can beat me. As soon as we beat you down, the Gyarados will be ours.
en: \bDon't think you can beat me. As soon as we beat you down, the Gyarados will be ours.
it: \bNon pensare di potermi battere. Appena ti avremo messo al tappeto, il Gyarados sarà nostro.

id: \bLet me give this to you as a thanks.
en: \bLet me give this to you as a thanks.

id: \bThat's a ball that will capture without fail. Use it well.
en: \bThat's a ball that will capture without fail. Use it well.
it: \bÈ una Ball che cattura senza mai fallire. Usala bene.

id: \bGet out of here before you get hurt.
en: \bGet out of here before you get hurt.

id: \bThe boss doesn't take well to uninvited guests.
en: \bThe boss doesn't take well to uninvited guests.
it: \bAl capo non piacciono gli ospiti indesiderati.

id: \bJust one person can't hope to stop us.
en: \bJust one person can't hope to stop us.
it: \bUna persona sola non può sperare di fermarci.

id: \rWe plan on using evolution to fuel our desires.
en: \rWe plan on using evolution to fuel our desires.
it: \rUseremo l'evoluzione per alimentare i nostri desideri.

id: \rThere are too many of us. You can't win.
en: \rThere are too many of us. You can't win.
